objective: To register and maintain the trucking companies (vendors of TC-PBR): add, update, delete, search and export.
To keep Vendor Code, SAP Vendor Code and NPWP unique among active trucking companies, so that every vendor in Daily, Monthly, SA and PAS can be identified without ambiguity.
To keep deleted trucking companies for history (logical delete): they stay visible with Deletion = Yes but can no longer be updated or used in new transactions.

operation.text: 5.1 Initial Display
Title 'Master Trucking Company', breadcrumb 'Master - Trucking Company'.
Form in Add Mode: all fields blank, Service Type = MRO, mode info 'Mode: Add'.
List: all trucking companies, active and deleted, sorted by Vendor Name; 10 rows per page; audit columns hidden. No data: message no. 22.

SELECT VENDOR_NAME, VENDOR_CD, SAP_VENDOR_CD, SERVICE_TYPE, NPWP, CONTACT_NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, MOBILE_PHONE, ADDRESS, DELETION_FLAG, CREATED_BY, CREATED_DT, CHANGED_BY, CHANGED_DT, VERSION FROM Trucking Company Master (TBD) ORDER BY VENDOR_NAME (column names TBD)
5.2 Input Normalisation (client and again server)

rows: pt.  maju bersama -> PT. MAJU BERSAMA
Digits only, then 999.999.999.9-999.999 (on leaving the field)

operation.text: 5.3 Save (Add / Update)

items: Step 1 - Mandatory (MT-01): Vendor Name, Vendor Code, SAP Vendor Code, NPWP (message no. 1). Service Type always has a value.

Step 2 - Length and format (MT-02..MT-11): lengths (no. 2); Vendor Code 3 letters / numbers (no. 3); SAP Vendor Code 10 digits (no. 5); Service Type in list (no. 7); NPWP 16 digits (no. 8); E-Mail (no. 10), Phone (no. 11), Mobile Phone (no. 12) only when filled.

Step 3 - Uniqueness among ACTIVE vendors (DELETION_FLAG = 'N'), the edited row excluded: Vendor Code (no. 4), SAP Vendor Code (no. 6), NPWP compared on digits (no. 9). A code of a deleted vendor may be used again (OP-04).
Step 4 - Update only (MT-12 / MT-13): Vendor Code unchanged (no. 13); row not deleted (no. 14); VERSION unchanged (no. 15).
Step 5 - Add: INSERT (Data Map block 1). Update: UPDATE ... WHERE key AND VERSION = :version (block 2).
Step 6 - COMMIT; on exception ROLLBACK and message no. 24.
Success: form reset to Add Mode, search cleared, list refreshed; message no. 16 / 17.
All errors of steps 1-3 are shown together under their fields; the first error field gets the focus.

operation.text: 5.4 Update
Update (✎) loads all fields and the VERSION into the form; Vendor Code is read only; the row is highlighted; the page scrolls to the form.
Cancel discards the changes and returns to Add Mode.
Rows with Deletion = Yes cannot be updated (button disabled; server check no. 14).
5.5 Delete (logical)
Delete (🗑) shows confirmation no. 19.
MT-21: rejected when the vendor is used by an open transaction (message no. 20). Mock-up examples: PO Monthly in status Pending, active Daily Order, PR Monthly not finished. Exact list TBD (OP-05).
Otherwise UPDATE DELETION_FLAG = 'Y' (block 3) WHERE key AND VERSION; 0 rows -> no. 15. The row stays in the list with Deletion = Yes, Update / Delete disabled; message no. 21.
Deleted vendors cannot be selected in new transactions (Daily, Monthly, DTP data mapping). There is no Restore (OP-06).
5.6 Search, Sort, Table View, Export .xls
Search (MT-30): while typing, partial and case-insensitive on all columns (Deletion as Yes / No, dates as DD.MM.YYYY HH:MI); returns to page 1; no match: no. 22.
Sort: click a column header; again to reverse. Default Vendor Name ascending.
Table View: show / hide columns; default hidden Created By / Date, Updated By / Date.

Export .xls (MT-31): SpreadsheetML (Excel), sheet 'Trucking Company', bold header; all rows of the current search (all pages), visible columns only; file 'Master_Trucking_Company_YYYYMMDD.xls'; message no. 23.
5.7 Paging
Rows per page (Tampilkan) 10 / 25 / 50, default 10; ‹ pages ›; 'Showing n to m of x records (filtered from y total entries)'.
5.8 Concurrency, Security and Audit
Optimistic locking with VERSION on Update and Delete; each Save / Delete is one DB transaction.
Access: IELP Admin (assumed; View / Add / Update / Delete / Export, TBD OP-07).
MT-22: CREATED_BY / CREATED_DT on insert; CHANGED_BY / CHANGED_DT on update and delete (login user, server time).
5.9 Open points

rows: Vendor Code 3 characters and SAP Vendor Code 10 digits confirmed? Old data 'PNJ' with SAP code 'PNJ' does not meet the rule. The Master KPI reference uses 'PS' (PT. Putra Soputan, 2 characters) and 'IBL' / 'IBT' for Iron Bird; PS is in the mock-up data as an exception.
NPWP 16 digits only, or must old 15-digit NPWP still be accepted?
Uniqueness only among active vendors (codes of deleted vendors re-usable) - confirm.
Which open transactions block Delete (active Daily Order, PR / PO Monthly pending, SA not completed, ...)?
Restore of a deleted vendor needed?
Who may add / update / delete (IELP Admin assumed)?
Vendor Code = Trucking Code in Daily / Monthly / DTP (e.g. DNX, PBM) - confirm; physical table / column names.
